The '''Qektoth attack cruiser''' was a modified strike cruiser employed by the [[Qektoth Confederation]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ships]] were armed with four [[Plasma cannon (Qektoth Confederation)|plasma cannons]] and a [[Bio-energy array]]. However, due to the energy requirements of its weapon systems, the attack cruiser could only use its shields in a single fire arc, leaving it vulnerable to flanking attacks.
